==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
The chapter starts with and Goh already arriving in Galar.
Ash and Goh stop to rest on a bench instead of eating scones, while the food stolen from them is changed to cupcakes.
's backstory of covering its fur in mud to fit in with its friends is removed, nor does it battle with .
The scenes of Ash, Goh, and Scorbunny on the train are removed. Scorbunny trying to meet Goh in the Wild Area is also omitted. 
Goh's goal to is revealed here as it wasn't mentioned in the previous chapter.
Ash and Goh get Gigantamax to jump over the train instead of moving off of the tracks.
